title: Customer Signals Taxonomy and Commitments for Console Analytics Deliverables
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Customers consistently request a mix of analytics deliverables from the Console: ad-hoc CSV exports, scheduled usage reports, per-tenant cost breakdowns, and dashboard access. We need a deterministic taxonomy of inbound signals, a lightweight scoring function that maps requests to commitment tiers (fast-track SLA, standard delivery, or longer advisory flow), and clear delivery promises for each tier. This ticket defines the taxonomy, proposes a scoring heuristic, documents edge cases (security/PII, very large exports), and records stakeholder alignment for enforcement in the intake UI and triage workflows.
scope: Define signal taxonomy (source, frequency, granularity, export size, sensitivity)
Create a scoring heuristic that outputs a delivery tier and estimated lead time
Specify gating rules for security/compliance review and Dedicated/Private customers
Produce copy and form changes required in Console intake flow
Deliver example routing outputs for 10 representative customer requests
proposed_scoring_algorithm: Score = weighted_sum([customer_tier:0.35, data_sensitivity:0.25, delivery_frequency:0.15, export_size:0.15, existing_dashboard:0.1]). Map score>0.75 -> Fast-Track (SLA 3 business days), 0.45-0.75 -> Standard (SLA 10 business days), <0.45 -> Advisory (can take 30+ days or require paid engagement). We will cap export sizes: >100GB flagged for engineering review and queued as custom work.
acceptance_criteria: A documented taxonomy with definitions for each signal field
A deterministic scoring function (formula + example calculations) checked against 10 sample requests
Intake form changes and copy written and approved by UX
SLAs and routing matrix agreed with Sales and Support
A list of follow-up engineering gating rules for large/PII exports

decisions: Use weighted heuristic rather than ML model for initial rollout to keep behavior transparent
Fast-Track SLA to be honored for enterprise customers when contract field present in intake form
Large exports (>100GB) moved to engineering review queue by default
Data classified as ‘sensitive’ will require Security review and cannot be auto-approved for exports
